question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **sulking**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sulking** means to be silent, morose, and bad-tempered out of annoyance or disappointment.

 
 
• **Example -** *He's **sulking** in his room because I wouldn't let him have any more chocolate.*
 
 
 
• ​Here in the given paragraph,** 'sulking'** is used as a verb to describe the sorrowness of the author's failure.
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'sulking'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Correct Paragraph:** *While I was sitting there (1) **sulking__** over my failure to keep from having to spend (2) _________ glistering summer months on the freaking Cote of Azur, Grandmere started (3)_________ me from the phone. She kept (4)_________ her fingers on the phone to catch my attention. I just sat there blinking at her until finally, she put her hand over the receiver and (5)_________ (so that nobody listens), “Amelia! In my bedroom, there is something for you”. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Smirking** means to smile in a way that expresses satisfaction or pleasure about having done something.
 
• **Grinning** means a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually showing pleasure or amusement.
 
• **Clapping** means to strike the palms of one's hands against one another resoundingly, and repeatedly to express approval.
